scientific_integrity: Conditional Gaussian age-mixture and Neyman–Pearson method credited as prior/general methodology. Exact formulas, large-N limits and averaged constant established by explicit proof; finite numerical checks only corroborate. Publication priority subject to possible implicit coverage in inaccessible full text.
scientific_limitations: All coordinates observed; independent Gaussian particles under common Poisson resets; calibrated known pair of candidate ages; equal prior; parameters κ,D,r,Δ fixed positive. The stationary average is of calibrated test errors, not risk for an unobserved reference age. Does not establish robustness to unknown parameters, observation error, or interactions. Full primary paper and all related supplements were not available for complete inspection.
title: A logarithmic reset-age discrimination horizon in a confined Brownian gas
